reviews.review_msg: This professor doesn't teach, lectures are assigned in a long wordy PPT along with a long reading. The 50min in-class time is a song and dance for a "reflective" diary entry which is a mini essay that is harshly marked. Writing instructions feel like constrains because TA grades it (not her) and is tough grader. Take this with a different prof.

topic was indigenous languages in canada! eye-opening course and i enjoyed it, despite it not being something i'm wholeheartedly interested in. heather is very nice and approachable, her TA gave good feedback as well! stay on top of the weekly journals/assignments. lecture notes are extremely helpful with studying and following along! [spring 2022]
This course was so fun! The lectures were great and the project was a lot of fun. I am not a linguistics major but I wish found this class earlier so I could take linguistics courses in my degree.
